name: @anizoptera/publish-clean
description: Checks and cleans the exact tarball npm is about to upload, then publishes those same bytes: verified exports and entry points, no secrets, no unresolved workspace specs, no dev noise in package.json. No dependencies, one JS file.
author: Anizoptera

scripts.check: bun run --parallel format:check claude-link:check doc-placement:check hooks:check readme:check typecheck tracked-artifacts:check && bun run build && bun run test:built && bun run cleaned-artifact:check
scripts.claude-link:check: test -L CLAUDE.md && test "$(readlink CLAUDE.md)" = AGENTS.md || { echo 'CLAUDE.md must be a symlink to AGENTS.md. Two real files drift apart in silence, and then each agent family reads different rules. Repair: ln -sf AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js verify
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:built
scripts.tracked-artifacts:check: test -z "$(git ls-files dist)" || { echo 'dist/ is build output and must never be tracked: a committed copy outlives the source it came from, and the publish checks read the freshly built CLI. Repair: git rm -r --cached dist' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.version: grep -qF "## [$npm_package_version]" CHANGELOG.md || { echo "CHANGELOG.md has no ## [$npm_package_version] section. Run: bun run changelog v$npm_package_version, edit it, then COMMIT it -- the bump refuses a dirty tree." >&2; exit 1; }
